feature_contract.goal: Preserve the full stage/checkpoint/GOAL result text producer-to-R84 eye path when native priority SpriteNode lists are replaced, including generic HUD glyph siblings, while keeping known-good original fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Bounded live priority-root/tail reachability for three original Sumo_Printf result parents, exact GOAL result text and generic BA9D0 HUD glyph calls. No changes to original timing, gameplay logic, SkyGlow, FFB/input, R26_SAFE, DX11 or frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original x86 Sumo_Printf, B9200 result text and generic HUD glyph calls now snapshot both native priority root and tail before their producer executes.
Post-call TagAppendedNodes requires original root identity and bounded live-tail reachability; newer exact nested producer generation stays authoritative.
Existing R84 R30/R33 per-eye draw consumers read only valid registered HUD SpriteNode provenance before x64 OpenXR composition; HMD optical correctness needs real hardware.
subcomponents: Bind stable-root proof to both generic HUD glyph/sprani children, all three stage/checkpoint Sumo_Printf producers and exact GOAL result text.
Preserve the source-entry registration serial so nested/newly stamped GOAL or foreign producers cannot be overwritten by the enclosing original call.
Exercise compile-time positive/negative queue ownership regression for live sibling, switched root with reused tail, detached tail, empty priority and foreign new tail.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original GOAL/checkpoint/result and common HUD text producer to R84 native screen HUD SpriteNode
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All live appended siblings preserve the native screen-HUD source when the original root and both tails remain reachable; exact nested owners survive.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Replaced/reused priority root, detached tail, nested foreign GOAL/World and original fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A rebuilt root or orphaned tail never borrows an earlier GOAL/HUD token, and unknown native drawing remains unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Final exact-SHA R84 x86 game, x64 host, R26_SAFE rollback and four required GitHub CI Gates
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Windows Active, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact all succeed for the same validation-bearing SHA while Quest3 remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Generic original HUD BA9D0 and exact Sumo_Printf/B9200 result calls may enqueue multiple native SpriteNodes while priority queue roots can be rebuilt and old tail pointers reattached.
source_trace: The old stage/checkpoint Sumo_Printf post-call path only cached tail_4 and passed no source-root identity to TagAppendedNodes.
The generic clipped glyph and animated glyph owners bypassed the bounded branch entirely, using stale oldTail->next_0 in an O(1) path.
B9200 result text also had only old tail and could register stale ScreenHud owner after a live list replacement; root proof and entry serial now fence nested sources.
alternatives_rejected: Do not infer root identity from matching old tail pointers; do not globally classify unknown glyphs or force generic D3DX Flush; do not disable native fallback or widen rank/lens/SkyGlow eye owner.
diagnosis.root_cause: The native HUD text entrypoints lacked a stable current-root proof when reusing pre-producer priority tails. OldTail node reuse/relinking could associate unrelated newly queued sprites with an earlier GOAL text producer.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material C++ source 2dc620415309580220c4ee60161a73d04b35324a changes native hooks_uiscaling.cpp to use stable root and source entry serial for stage/checkpoint, GOAL text and generic HUD clip/sprani.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: sprite_queue_tail_proof.hpp HudTextRootRebuildGuards compile-time tests distinguish live sibling, a new root reattaching the identical old tail, detached tail, empty-root first glyph and foreign new tail.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only proven source-owned native ScreenHud queued nodes can enter existing R84 per-eye HUD path; uncertainty still falls back to original rendering. No HMD was executed.

notes: Initial source commit failed Active policy because this run record did not yet exist. This same-TASK repair supplies the required substantive function contract; it does not change the material source or claim runtime visual PASS.
